why_best: This multi-faceted visual cycle provides equal editorial weight to three distinct pillars of the narrative while maintaining a dynamic rhythm suitable for a square social news feed.
why_bad: A linear flat slide transition would sever the visual relationship between the three facts and make the broadcast feel like a static slideshow.
trap: Failing to keep the primary information plane aligned with the viewer during its feature window, causing text to drift out of focus before it can be comfortably read.
